headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Hubspace accessories sold through Home Depot, including portable air conditioners.

dualColorSpace.title: Dual Color Space
dualColorSpace.description: Have RGB lights enumerate a second light which supports the temperature color space.

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often air conditioners are refreshed so that changes made on the unit itself or in the Hubspace app show up in the Home app. Set to 0 to disable. Values below 10 are treated as 10.
